messages:
Tara (Design): quick review of the vectors preview + CSV mapping grid. uploaded a compact figma: https://figma.com/file/preview-map
Ike (Frontend): nice frames. what's the single biggest keyboard/a11y risk we need to fix?
Tara (Design): the mapping grid isn't keyboard-navigable (tab only goes to controls). also when selecting across pages the header count resets on paginate which confuses users.
Jon (A11y): map grid should be a semantic table with roving tabindex/arrow-key nav and proper aria-live updates when mappings change. announce total selection like: '5 rows selected'. dialog must trap focus and return to the trigger on close.
Lena (PM): product priorities: default download should be "Download selected vectors (.jsonl)". CSV export must force a mapping step and show a live 3-row preview. allow saving mappings as presets per-user.
Marta (Backend): ok to persist presets and provide an endpoint GET /user/:id/mappings. export API accepts ids + mapping. for large exports (>8k rows) we'll queue and email a link when ready.
Ike (Frontend): implementation plan: 1) convert mapping area to a tabbable table with arrow-key support. 2) persist selection in localStorage + reconcile with server. 3) add an aria-live banner for selection and mapping updates. also add a keyboard-focus tooltip for truncated metadata cells and a copy icon (aria-label="Copy full value").
Tara (Design): microcopy tweak: primary CTA -> "Download selected vectors (.jsonl)" secondary -> "Export CSV — map columns". inline helper: "Preview updates as you map columns." Keep it brief.
Jon (A11y): color nit: relevance tag at 12px is under 3:1 contrast. use darker fill or white text on dark chip. also ensure sort buttons have aria-sort and announce change.
DeployBot: staging deploy completed with mapping updates. :rocket:
Tara (Design): next steps: Ike to do keyboard grid + aria-live; Marta to add presets endpoint; Jon to attach a 5-point a11y checklist to the PR; Lena to confirm final CTA copy. target: PRs by Wednesday EOD. :thumbsup:
